newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Transaero plans to fly to Hong Kong, Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Transaero plans to fly to Hong Kong, Thailand.

text.p: The private Russian airline Transaero plans to begin regular passenger flights from Moscow to Hong Kong in June and to Bangkok later this year, a company spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
Natalia Alexashina said that the company planned to introduce flights on Boeing 767 between Moscow and Hong Kong twice a week.
"We will lease this aircraft soon," Alexashina said, without giving any details.
She said Transaero also planned regular flights between Moscow and Bangkok later this year.
She also said Transaero was in the final stage of talks with Taiwan's China Airlines to start regular service between Moscow and Taipei.
Alexashina did not say when Transaero would begin regular flights between Russia and Taiwain.
Last week the Taiwan state-run Central News Agency said that Taiwan and Russia have reached aggreement on direct air links between both states.
Russia's Aeroflot International Airlines owns five per cent of Transaero.
